summary: Lithium Americas Corp. filed an 8-K disclosing entry into a Securities Purchase Agreement with YA II PN, Ltd. to issue up to $175 million in subordinated convertible debentures. Initially $150 million is issued, with $25 million available via delayed closings. Conversion price is the lower of a fixed price (higher of 140% of prior day NYSE closing and $3.79) or 95% of lowest five-day VWAP, subject to a floor of 50% of prior day close. Interest is 5% annually, rising to 7.5% or 15% upon specified events. Proceeds fund general corporate purposes. Cash repayments are restricted while Orion notes remain outstanding. This is a financing arrangement, not a typical special-situation event. Watch for conversion dynamics and registration effectiveness.
